title: Constrained 4-Layer Cr-Bounded Grid Search
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining the buried Cr layer thickness to [25,35] nm will recover performance by operating in the low-loss critical-damping regime, avoiding the high-absorption degradation observed in round 2.
design_principle: Metal-dielectric multilayer with admittance locus method; thin Cr layer provides controlled absorption in visible while dielectric layers manage interference for IR reflectance.
proposed_topology: Air | SiO2 | Cr | HfO2 | SiO2 | Al substrate; 4 finite layers total
manufacturing_considerations: Cr thickness bounded to 25-35nm for reproducibility
theory_basis: Admittance locus method for metal-dielectric stacks
Critical damping regime for thin metal layers
expected_advantages: Cr thickness in optimal absorption window
known_risks: May still not exceed round 1 best score of 0.6209
Limited degrees of freedom with only 4 layers
execution_request_english: Optimize a 4-layer spectrally selective absorber stack on Al substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: SiO2 | Cr | HfO2 | SiO2. Wavelength bands: 400-700nm maximize absorptance, 700-2000nm maximize reflectance. Design variables: all four layer thicknesses. Hard constraint: Cr layer thickness bounded to [25.0, 35.0] nm. Initialize optimizer with dense grid sweep centered at Cr=30.0nm, other layers at quarter-wave values for 550nm. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer. Total finite layer count: 4. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 400-700 nm, 700-2000 nm. soft objectives: high absorptance in 400-700 nm; low reflectance in 400-700 nm; high reflectance in 700-2000 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflectance in 400-700 nm; high absorptance in 700-2000 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 20.
revision_reason: Direct implementation of feedback directive: constrain Cr layer to [25,35]nm with grid initialization centered at 30nm to recover from round 2 score regression
